tagline: Leading OTC health and personal care brand portfolio with strong retail distribution
hero_kpi_rationale: Stable and robust operating cash flow of $251.5 million in 2025, demonstrating consistent cash generation from the OTC model with established brand leverage and strong retail distribution

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from core business operations before capital expenditures and financing activities.
kpis.description: Net cash provided by operating activities was $251.5 million for 2025 compared to $248.9 million for 2024, representing a $2.6 million increase driven by improved net income before non-cash items.
kpis.signal: Stable operational cash generation demonstrating business resilience

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Cash spent each year for new equipment, facility improvements, or manufacturing infrastructure.
kpis.description: Net cash used in investing activities was $17.5 million for 2025 compared to $20.1 million for 2024, primarily due to a decrease in capital expenditures of $1.3 million. The prior year included a manufacturing acquisition in Australia.
kpis.signal: Lower investing activities reflect modest capex discipline and absence of major acquisitions in 2025

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.explanation: Aggregate principal amount of senior notes and term loans outstanding.
kpis.description: As of March 31, 2025, total outstanding indebtedness of $1.0 billion consists of $400.0 million of 5.125% Senior Notes due January 15, 2028 and $600.0 million of 3.750% Senior Notes due April 1, 2031. The 2012 Term Loan was fully repaid and all related commitments terminated during fiscal 2025.
kpis.signal: Debt reduction achieved through repayment of 2012 Term Loan in fiscal 2025

kpis.name: Top Customer Concentration
kpis.explanation: Percentage of gross revenues from Walmart and Amazon combined.
kpis.description: During 2025, Walmart and Amazon accounted for approximately 19% and 14% of gross revenues respectively, together representing 33% of gross revenues. The company has no long-term agreements with these customers.
kpis.signal: Significant customer concentration risk with top two customers representing one-third of revenues

kpis.name: Liquidity - ABL Revolver
kpis.explanation: Undrawn borrowing capacity available under the asset-based lending credit facility.
kpis.description: As of March 31, 2025, the company had no balance outstanding on the 2012 ABL Revolver (total capacity $200.0 million, extended to December 8, 2028) and available borrowing capacity of $165.7 million.
kpis.signal: Adequate liquidity position with $165.7 million available borrowing capacity

risks.title: Supply shortages and logistics chain
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited in the first section of risk factors with strong language ("shortages", "backorders", "negatively impacted"). It is exacerbated by persistent macroeconomic conditions. The Industrial category is highly weighted for direct operational impact.

risks.title: Inflation and cost pressure
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions an inflationary environment, rising shipping and material costs, with a direct impact on profitability. The language is repeated and emphasizes volatility. Context stable vs N-1.

risks.title: Risk of intangible asset impairment
risks.score_rationale: Intangible assets represent more than 80% of total assets. A $48.8 million impairment was recorded in 2023. The text highlights that future declines could lead to additional charges. Language is very cautious and repeated.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party manufacturers
risks.score_rationale: The text indicates that certain third-party manufacturers are unable to meet demand, causing shortages. This reveals a structural weakness in the value chain. Risk reiterated with moderate intensity.

risks.title: Changing consumer purchasing behaviors
risks.score_rationale: The shift to online shopping and evolving consumer habits are cited as risk factors. The language is forward-looking and emphasizes uncertainty. Consistent with sector trends.

risks.title: Interest rate and discount rate sensitivity
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly links impairment tests to discount rates (WACC). Rising rates have already caused an impairment in 2023. High weighting due to direct impact on asset valuation.

risks.title: Dependence on promotional programs
risks.score_rationale: Customer programs (discounts, cooperative advertising) are integrated as a revenue adjustment variable. The risk is moderate but real under increased competitive pressure. Technical language but not alarmist.

ai_positioning.summary: PBH does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its financial report.
